title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Part 2 of 5 for issue #3: Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #3, then do ONLY Part 2.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): serialize DOM nodes with script stripping (#3)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Implement `serializeNode` for Document, Doctype, Element, Text, Comment with attributes. Strip script content and `on*` attributes. Put the code in `packages/recorder/src/snapshot/`. Use the `Mirror` from Part 1 for node ids and the serialized node shape from `@rewind/shared` (see ADR 0004).

Requirements:
- Boolean attributes stored as `true`
- `<script>` kept as an empty element
- No `on*` attribute in output

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- happy-dom fixture tests for a simple and a nested page

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): serialize DOM nodes with script stripping (#3)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" -m "..."`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and update docs/decisions/README.md.

Push to the existing branch `day-03/do
